findings.decision: Capture utility-dialog opener before hiding Settings; restore usable opener or toggle on close. Specialized pack/detail handling retained.
Capture queue initiating control before blur; restore connected control or matching stable ID/list after cancellation. Guard deferred focus and scroll by owner generation.
Settings Escape explicitly restores its toggle.

findings.adjudication: confirmed busy-state loss; completion evidence qualified
findings.decision: Synchronous enabled Close handoff before hiding/disabling focused publish/export controls. Completion never restores a stale initiating control; synchronous preview replacement preserves the user’s current control. Separate publish/PNG browser checks; original audit final measurement followed a download.

Completion announces placement in existing status regions. No general completion-focus change: audit did not isolate origin-specific intended focus and search intentionally avoids keyboard reopening; scope keeps completion navigation unchanged.
Search-origin cancel deliberately does not focus the text input, avoiding mobile keyboard reopening. Existing behavior preserved.
Associate all three visible headings with their native dialogs using aria-labelledby; actual screen-reader speech remains untested.

rejectedAlerts.RFP-01: Native-dialog BODY/browser-chrome Tab step alone is not background-page escape. Preserve native controls.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-03: WebKit default Tab configuration; use Option-Tab.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-04: Narrow-layout anomaly not reproducible in fresh controls; no redesign.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-05: Transient contrast explanation remains inference; no blanket contrast claim.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-06: Original reorder selector error; existing keyboard reorder positive control.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-08: Unrendered handles are not measured targets.
rejectedAlerts.RFP-09: Axe heading best-practice alerts do not alone establish WCAG failure.

additionalFindings.decision: Bind deferred Dogs cancellation focus/scroll to captured owner generation; avoids stale UI focus after account switch.

Store Dogs publishing/revoking progress and error messages in shareLinkState so generic account refreshes cannot immediately overwrite their status text. No write semantics changed.
